name: AbsorbPointer
description: A widget that prevents its subtree from receiving pointer events. It still participates in layout and painting but absorbs any touches, gestures, or pointer interactions.

properties.name: absorbing
properties.description: Whether to absorb (block) pointer events. If true, the child cannot be interacted with.

properties.name: ignoringSemantics
properties.description: Whether to ignore the semantics of the child for accessibility. Useful when disabling interactions but keeping or removing semantics.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree that will be prevented from receiving pointer events.
